acceptance: One predicate decides whether a per-run checkpoint is held or closed (live lease, not enabled, phase end or aborted); perRunVerdict and core.laneQuotaPaused both call it, and the aborted phase is a named constant.
core exports the quota checkpoint reason; checkpoint.ReasonQuotaLikely is defined from it, and the bare literal in cmd/evolve/cmd_loop_control.go is replaced.
A core helper builds the request of a resumed cycle (the checkpoint goal governs), and cmd/evolve resumedRequest uses it.
100% coverage on each changed function; docs in STE (checkpoint-resume.md and the core package note).
fix: Extract heldOrClosed(perRunState) from perRunVerdict and laneQuotaPaused; export the quota reason from core and alias it in checkpoint; move the resume-goal rule of resumedRequest into a core constructor.
